meta.source: Goose chat history + Discord + Plane sync audit
meta.import_note: Plane does not have a native bulk JSON import via UI. Use CSV for UI import, or POST individual issues via /api/v1/workspaces/executive/projects/{id}/issues/

Update Infisical so PLANE_API_KEY exports the working token, or update the sync recipe to read from 8-13-26GooseSyncBot directly. Otherwise the scheduled sync will fail with 403 Forbidden.

Do NOT paste new values into chat.
